ruling.recommended_action: Route to Ryde Trust & Safety for manual review: pull the full unthinned GPS trace and post-trip telemetry for T-2046, check for hard-braking / harsh-acceleration / shoulder-use evidence and any road-camera or LTA incident data on AYE (SYN-1002) and Jurong Town Hall Road (SYN-1003) between 21:22–21:35, and if the dangerous-driving allegation is corroborated, proceed under the Code of Conduct / account-review process. Inform the rider of the RydeHELP report path; if any injury occurred, 995 and the driver's commercial motor insurance route. No fare or cancellation adjustment in this ticket (the fare of $21.04 is a fixed RydeX quote with no unapproved add-ons).
ruling.escalation_reason: Dispute type is safety (alleged speeding, hard braking, overtaking on the shoulder); per SAFE-1/SAFE-2 this is not decided by automated ruling and is referred to a human reviewer with the unthinned GPS trace and any telematics on the AYE / Jurong Town Hall Road segment (21:22–21:35).

rejected_claims.reason: Rider's speeding/hard-braking/shoulder-overtaking allegation is a safety complaint and cannot be adjudicated automatically; escalated for manual review. No GPS sample in the record supports a speed in excess of 44.1 km/h, and the thinned trace cannot resolve braking or shoulder behaviour either way.

Driver's statement that he drove normally is a bare denial and, under the system-records-over-statements rule, cannot by itself dispose of the safety allegation; the full trace must be reviewed by a human.
No fare-related relief is available: the RydeX fare is a fixed upfront quote with no unapproved add-ons, cancellation fee or waiting fee, so there is no amount to refund or waive in this ticket.
